# Release notes

## November 18
- We shipped `claude-opus-6`, our most capable model. See [the guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/claude-opus-9).
- Claude Opus 7 is coming soon and will change how you work.
- Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) stays the default.
- `claude-fable-5-1` was retired today. Requests to it now fail.
